# NexCort iQ

> NexCort iQ is a real-time public safety intelligence platform that enhances — and does not replace — existing emergency communications infrastructure, CAD software, dispatch workflows, and human personnel.

## About

**Company:** Apps on Demand LLC, doing business as NexCort iQ
**Website:** https://www.nexcortiq.us
**Formerly known as:** Rapid Cortex (brand updated 2026)
**Sector:** Public safety technology, emergency communications, security operations

NexCort iQ deploys as an intelligence and decision-support layer alongside the systems agencies already use. It is not a CAD replacement, telephony replacement, or autonomous dispatch system. Human dispatchers remain in control of all critical decisions.

## Products

### NexCort iQ Core — 911 / PSAP Intelligence Platform
Real-time AI assistance for 911 dispatch centers and PSAPs (Public Safety Answering Points).

Capabilities include:
- Live call transcription with speaker identification
- Multilingual communication support (English/Spanish standard; additional languages agency-configured)
- Two-Way Text / NG911 caller messaging (SMS, photo, video, location)
- Supervisor situational awareness dashboard
- SOP compliance monitoring and discrepancy detection
- CAD-complementary incident intelligence (does not write to CAD without dispatcher approval)
- Pre-Arrival iQ: real-time caller tracking and responder coordination via SMS
- Secure audio/video assist for active callers (Rapid Vision integration available)

Deployment: Works alongside existing CAD (Motorola PremierOne, Tyler New World, Console1, and others). Does not require CAD replacement or telephony replacement.

### NEXiQ — Non-Emergency Call Automation
Conversational AI for police non-emergency lines, 311 city services, and municipal call centers.

Built on: Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex V2, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Polly.

Capabilities:
- Automated intake for non-emergency caller requests
- Intelligent triage and routing to correct departments
- Multilingual non-emergency call handling
- Reduction in non-emergency call volume handled by human dispatchers
- Self-service options for callers with common non-emergency needs

**Important:** NEXiQ handles non-emergency calls only. Emergency (911) calls are never intercepted or delayed.

### iQ Vision — AI Scene Intelligence
AI-powered video analysis and incident detection for security operations centers, campus safety teams, and venue security.

Capabilities:
- Real-time AI observation generation from camera streams
- Incident detection and structured observation notifications
- Live transcript intelligence from video streams
- Integration with existing camera infrastructure (does not require camera replacement)
- Viewer access for authorized security personnel

### NexCort iQ Campus
Campus safety platform for universities, colleges, K-12 institutions, and educational facilities.

Capabilities:
- QR code emergency reporting — no mobile app required
- NFC tap-to-report for Blue Light poles and campus infrastructure
- Campus incident tracking and coordination
- Campus dispatch support with AI assistance
- Blue Light Connect integration for activated emergency poles
- Clery Act-aware incident logging support

### NexCort iQ Venue
Venue security and safety operations platform for stadiums, arenas, convention centers, and entertainment venues.

Capabilities:
- QR/NFC incident reporting for guests and staff
- Security staff coordination and dispatch
- Venue incident intelligence and operations visibility
- Real-time situational awareness for large-event security operations

### NexCort iQ Transit
Transit safety management software for transit agencies, bus networks, and rail operations.

Capabilities:
- Incident reporting for distributed transit operations
- Security and operations coordination across routes and facilities
- Real-time safety visibility for transit operations centers

### CAD Interoperability — CAD-to-CAD Hub
Multi-agency CAD interoperability solution that connects agencies using different CAD platforms.

Capabilities:
- Bidirectional incident sharing across heterogeneous CAD systems
- Multi-agency coordination without replacing existing CAD software
- Border or mutual-aid scenario support

## Deployment Model

NexCort iQ is a SaaS platform deployed on AWS (us-east-1).

- Cloud-hosted: no on-premise hardware required
- API-based CAD integration: connects to existing CAD systems without replacing them
- 60-Day Free Pilot available for qualified agencies

## Qualified Buyer Profiles

NexCort iQ serves:
- 911 centers and PSAPs (Public Safety Answering Points)
- Emergency communications centers (ECCs)
- Law enforcement agencies
- Fire departments
- EMS providers
- Emergency management agencies
- University and college campus safety / campus police
- Stadium and arena security operations
- Transit agency security and operations
- Municipal 311 / non-emergency call centers

## Accurate Claims Only

This document describes production capabilities of NexCort iQ as of its current deployment. NexCort iQ:

- DOES complement existing CAD systems
- DOES require dispatchers to approve CAD data submissions (CAD writeback is not automatic)
- DOES NOT replace emergency telephony systems
- DOES NOT replace CAD systems
- DOES NOT replace human dispatchers
- DOES NOT guarantee full compatibility with all CAD vendors (ask about specific CAD integration scope)
- DOES NOT automatically certify agencies as CJIS compliant or NG911 certified simply by deployment
